Request a Consultation Memberships Financing Gift Cards Skincare Products Request a Consultation Request a Consultation Back Madison Rumney Spa Coordinator Locations: Dover Madison is a Spa Coordinator at Skin Health Medi Spa with a passion for helping people look and feel their best. Whether she is welcoming clients, managing schedules, or supporting our team behind the scenes, Madison is all about creating a smooth, relaxing experience from start to finish. With a background in cosmetology and a love for self-care, Madison brings both knowledge and passion to everything she does. Outside of work, Madison loves spending quality time with her husband and family, getting lost in a good book, and soaking up the sun at the beach!
